# Greenfield Scenario (SCN-A) Checklist: Agentic Software Engineering System: URL Shortener

**Purpose**: Validate that the SCN-A requirements (expiration and basic analytics) are complete, unambiguous and testable, including failure paths.
**Created**: 2026-10-15
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [ADRs](../../../docs/adr/README.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.
**Item tags**: `[Mandatory]` means the criterion derives from the constitution, an approved requirement, or an accepted ADR or ruling. `[Optional]` means it concerns an enhancement. `[Dnn]` refers to a detection from the checklist brief; the detection map is in [../gates/release-evidence-gates.md](../gates/release-evidence-gates.md). Post-implementation evidence checks are in that gates file, not here. Every item is unchecked, including `[Optional]` items, so `/speckit-implement` reports this file as incomplete until a reviewer marks it.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Is the SCN-A capability bounded to FR-SHR-008 to FR-SHR-012, with nothing else in scope? [Clarity, Spec §SCN-A; HD-002] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the SCN-A input requirement specified, or required to be authored, so that it passes all five quality checks? [Completeness, Plan §11.1; Spec §SCN-A-AC1] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the expected decomposition content specified (tasks, dependencies, API and schema impacts, acceptance criteria)? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-A-AC2] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK004 Is the SCN-A contract increment (1.1.0) specified with its compatibility class? [Completeness, contracts/README.md Planned increments] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the expected terminal outcome specified (COMPLETED, staging R1), together with the failure-path outcomes? [Completeness, Plan §11.1] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Are the criteria for "no clarification gate needed" objective, with each check having a pass rule? [Measurability, Spec §SCN-A-AC1, §SCN-A-AC5] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the negative criterion "no artificially raised clarification gate" testable (any raised gate must cite a failed check)? [Measurability, Spec §SCN-A-AC5] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the late-ambiguity path specified: which path suspends, where siblings stop, and the resume point? [Clarity, Spec §SCN-A-AC4; ADR-017] [D21] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK009 Are expiration boundary rules specified (UTC; expired when resolution time ≥ expiration)? [Clarity, Spec §A-014] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the expired outcome distinguishable from not-found by both status code and reason code? [Clarity, Spec §FR-SHR-008; contracts/README.md] [Mandatory]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are analytics exactness and fallback semantics consistent with the Human Gate 4 ruling? [Consistency, Spec §A-013, §FR-SHR-011; ADR-019] [Mandatory]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the SCN-A required-evidence list consistent with the amended SC-002? [Consistency, Spec §SCN-A; Spec §SC-002 (CR-003)] [Mandatory]

## Ambiguities and Conflicts

- [ ] CHK013 Is the SCN-A classification rationale (new capability through optional fields and new endpoints, no change to existing behavior) stated together with the additive-change check that replaces full impact analysis, and is the outcome specified if that check fails? [Completeness, Spec §SCN-A Classification rationale, §SCN-A-AC6 (CR-003); Plan §3.2 ST-05 condition] [Mandatory]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- `[Gap]` = the requirement is missing; `[Ambiguity]` = the term or rule needs a definition; `[Conflict]` = two sources disagree; `[Assumption]` = relies on an unvalidated assumption
